passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the consolidated financial statements and related notes contained in Item 8, and the discussion of risks and cautionary factors that may affect future results in Item 1A. Risk Factors . Description of Our Company We are a leading international consumer goods company, actively delivering a smoke-free future. We are evolving our portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. Our current product portfolio primarily consists of cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, nicotine pouch and e-vapor products. Since 2008, we have invested over $16 billion to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke, with the goal of completely ending the sale of cigarettes. This investment includes the building of world-class scientific assessment capabilities, notably in the areas of pre-clinical systems toxicology, clinical and behavioral research, as well as post-market studies. In November 2022, we acquired Swedish Match AB ("Swedish Match") – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free combination led by the companies’ IQOS and ZYN brands. As of April 30, 2024, we hold the full rights to commercialize IQOS in the U.S. after reaching an agreement to end our U.S. commercial relationship covering IQOS with Altria Group, Inc. in 2022. Following a robust science-based review, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") has authorized the marketing of Swedish Match’s General snus and ZYN nicotine pouches and versions of PMI’s IQOS devices and consumables - the first-ever such authorizations in their respective categories. Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk Tobacco Product ("MRTP") authorizations from the FDA. We describe the MRTP orders in more detail in the "Business Environment" section of this Item 7. Following the sale of Vectura Group Ltd. on December 31, 2024, we updated our segment reporting in January 2025 by including the ongoing Wellness results (previously referred to as Wellness & Healthcare) in the Europe segment. In addition, we renamed our “PMI Duty Free” business to “PMI Global Travel Retail” effective in the first quarter of 2025. As a result of this change, our segment that includes our duty free business was renamed East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail (“EA, AU & PMI GTR”). As of December 31, 2025, our four geographical segments were as follows: • Europe Region, including our Wellness business; • South and Southeast Asia, Commonwealth of Independent States, Middle East and Africa Region ("SSEA, CIS & MEA"); • East Asia, Australia, and PMI Global Travel Retail (“EA, AU & PMI GTR”); and • Americas Region. credit_strengths.text: PMI's operating margin is exceptionally high for Consumer Staples, reflecting premium cigarette and smoke-free pricing power. Revenue and operating income have grown steadily across the three-year trend, while operating cash flow has remained robust, supporting substantial internal cash generation even as the company invests in smoke-free commercialization.

Interest coverage is comfortably above the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is in line with peers. This combination provides a solid buffer against earnings volatility, with the indicative financial risk profile placing leverage in a moderate tier and cash flow in a lower tier, suggesting some reliance on continued EBITDA stability.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses that PMI's short-term borrowings include bank loans with a high average year-end rate, and commercial paper capacity is available but currently undrawn. This mix exposes the company to floating-rate risk and potential refinancing pressure if market conditions tighten, particularly given the concentration of maturities in the near term.

Risk factors highlight the company's ongoing transition to smoke-free products, which requires sustained investment and may face regulatory hurdles. The debt maturity profile shows a significant portion due within the next twelve months, and while cash flow covers it, any operational setback could strain liquidity given the current ratio below one.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers interest expense and capital expenditures, with free cash flow remaining substantial. However, dividends absorb the majority of free cash flow, leaving limited retained cash for debt reduction. This shareholder return policy constrains deleveraging capacity, making debt service dependent on stable operating performance.

The maturity profile is manageable, with near-term maturities well covered by cash and operating cash flow. Yet the current ratio is slightly below one, indicating that current liabilities exceed current assets, which could pressure liquidity if cash flow generation slows. Access to commercial paper programs provides additional flexibility.

overall_credit_view.text: PMI's credit profile is supported by strong profitability, robust cash flow, and a leading position in the global tobacco and smoke-free industry. Leverage sits slightly below the sector median, and interest coverage is above peers, indicating solid debt-servicing capacity. The indicative financial risk profile is moderate, with headroom to the next leverage threshold.

Forward-looking, the company's ability to deleverage is constrained by substantial shareholder distributions, which consume most free cash flow. While the smoke-free transition offers growth potential, it also carries execution and regulatory risks. We view the credit as stable, with leverage expected to remain near current levels absent a significant EBITDA increase or debt reduction.

credit_strengths.text: PMI的營運利潤率在消費必需品行業中異常高，反映其優質香煙及無煙產品的定價能力。收入及營運收入在三年趨勢中穩步增長，而營運現金流保持強勁，支持大量內部現金生成，即使公司投資於無煙產品商業化。
利息覆蓋率舒適地高於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率與同業一致。這一組合為盈利波動提供了堅實緩衝，指示性財務風險狀況將槓桿置於中等級別，現金流置於較低級別，表明在一定程度上依賴持續的EBITDA穩定性。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露，PMI的短期借款包括平均年末利率較高的銀行貸款，商業票據額度可用但目前未提取。這種組合使公司面臨浮動利率風險及若市場條件收緊可能出現的再融資壓力，尤其考慮到短期內到期的集中度。
風險因素強調公司持續向無煙產品轉型，這需要持續投資並可能面臨監管障礙。債務到期狀況顯示相當一部分將在未來十二個月內到期，雖然現金流足以覆蓋，但若營運出現任何挫折，鑑於流動比率低於一，可能對流動性造成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運現金流輕鬆覆蓋利息支出及資本開支，自由現金流仍然可觀。然而，股息吸收了大部分自由現金流，留下有限的留存現金用於削減債務。這種股東回報政策限制了去槓桿能力，使債務償付依賴於穩定的營運表現。
到期狀況可控，近期到期債務由現金及營運現金流充分覆蓋。然而，流動比率略低於一，表明流動負債超過流動資產，若現金流生成放緩，可能對流動性造成壓力。商業票據計劃的可用性提供了額外靈活性。

overall_credit_view.text: PMI的信用狀況得到強勁盈利能力、穩健現金流以及在全球煙草及無煙行業領先地位的支持。槓桿略低於行業中位數，利息覆蓋率高於同業，表明債務償付能力穩固。指示性財務風險狀況為中等，距離下一個槓桿門檻有緩衝空間。
前瞻性來看，公司的去槓桿能力受到大量股東分派的限制，這些分派消耗了大部分自由現金流。雖然無煙轉型提供增長潛力，但也伴隨執行及監管風險。我們認為信用狀況穩定，預計槓桿將維持在當前水平附近，除非EBITDA顯著增加或債務減少。
